annotations.text: Left edge → right is the system «back» on iPhone (the thread would close), so I moved the swipe to the right edge, pulling leftwards. If you really want it from the left, we would have to turn off back-swipe in threads.
I recommend A: one safe gesture, part of the thread stays visible, and it is the desktop panel's tabs 1:1. B is here for comparison.
